note: Set A is better because it correctly identifies the general note regarding the 1/2" edge radius and accurately extracts the W10X15 section for Floor Beam @ Grid 5, whereas Set B incorrectly assigns W8X13 to the Floor Beam near Grid 5 (confusing it with the Roof Beam). Both sets struggle with binding specific dimensions to the correct beam details, often mixing values from different diagrams (e.g., assigning 3'-7" to Grid 5 instead of Grid 4), but Set A has fewer factual errors regarding component properties and sections.
